T701 has risen to 345.451 °C while T702 is 75.965 °C and T712 58.322 °C; the isolated trend suggests a temperature-measurement fault but does not establish thermocouple drift.
Reflux flow is 0.047 L/h and distillate flow 0.416 L/h (ratio about 0.113), inconsistent with FYI702 3.902 if it represents the contemporaneous reflux/distillate ratio.
